# Credits {.unnumbered}

The chapter list was constructed by surveying 12
publicly-available syllabi from major US biostatistics
programmes (documented in `docs/syllabi-survey.md`) and
adopting the topics that appeared in three or more of them.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the Python script
at `images/build-cover.py`. Watercolour palette: deep
slate through silver-blue to warm gold and pale cream,
anchored on a brand slate blue-grey `#4a5a6c`. Typography:
Avenir family (Apple system font); body text in Source
Serif 4.
